payload.rationale: This document is a sprint retro that directly echoes the prior Sprint 4 Retro (2026-03-22): same async decision widget, same 23-point velocity claim, same Zephyr-as-key-unlock attribution. I expanded the prior retro document and its core positions (Sprint4ThesisProven, ZephyrIntegrationUnlock, CoreFeatureDecisionCapture) so the passes can link or distinguish this retro from the March one. I included the velocity and Zephyr-rate-limit observations plus the metric-anchoring style observation because this document uses the same quantified-claim register. The three core narratives (DecisionCaptureAtConsensus, DecisionsEvaporate, AntiSlackPositioning) and the anti-pattern position frame the product context the widget ships into. ContextPreservationNextSprint is included because this retro may update or extend the next-sprint focus. I deliberately did NOT expand pricing positions (PricingTwelveDollars, PricingTier25Plus), webhook architecture, product category, or target market — none are referenced or implied by this short retro.
